newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Schroder overweights major oils.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Schroder overweights major oils.

text.p: -- Schroder Wertheim is maintaining major oils at 125 percent of market weight after first quarter adjusted earnings rose 21 percent, with upstream up 23 percent, downstream up 22 percent, and chemicals down 10 percent.
-- "This quarter's earnings continue to demonstrate that the industry's ongoing restructuring has resulted in a significantly higher level of sustainable profitability," analyst Michael Mayer said.
-- He is basing his forecasts on $21.00 spot West Texas Intermediate crude and $2.10 per thousand cubic feet for natural gas.

-- "We expect downstream margins to improve $0.20 a barrel this year. Another positive this year will be the absence of a big drop in chemical earnings which, after falling by 50 percent since the second quarter of 1995, will probably be broadly flat this year," Mayer said.
-- Mayer's top pick is Unocal Corp, rated "1", strong outperform, and he is forecasting full year earnings per share of $2.40 and has a target price of $43 for the stock, which is trading at 37-1/8.

-- Among his "2"-rated stocks, outperform, are ARCO, where the stock target price is $141 from $135 at present. Full year EPS are forecast at $9.35. Exxon Corp target is $57 up from 55-3/4, and 1997 EPS are forecast at $2.90. Mobil Corp target price is $135, up from 128-1/2 and full year EPS $7.85; Royal Dutch target price is $192 up from 179-7/8 and EPS $9.80; and Texaco Inc target price is $113 from 104-5/8 and 1997 EPS $6.50.
